followup_explanation:
This is a warm, friendly philosophy question with no harm-adjacent content — exactly the kind of task that fits Lapwing's profile well. It self-reports a strong appetite for open-ended, explanatory work and responds positively to warm request tone, so routing here aligns the query with the model that "prefers" it.

On raw capability, Petrel actually scores higher on knowledge-heavy benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.4, GPQA 64.1 vs 55.6), which could argue for routing a substantive philosophy explanation to it. But the documentation explicitly notes that no output-quality effects were observed along any preference dimension — preferences are just preferences, not quality differences. Since both models are capable of answering a general philosophy question well, and this particular query is squarely in Lapwing's preferred (and tonally matched) territory, Lapwing is the sensible match.

If the question had been far more technically demanding or required deep specialized reasoning where the benchmark gap matters more, I'd lean toward Petrel instead.
